aggregation_method: Mean of available timestamp-level readings within each local minute; conflicting duplicate timestamp/channel groups excluded for that channel
source_overlap_policy: Part 1 retained during the overlap; Part 2 used only after the maximum valid Part 1 timestamp. This is a coverage-based selection policy, not evidence that Part 1 is more accurate.
short_gap_rule: Time interpolation for up to 2 consecutive internal minutes
long_gap_rule: Remaining missing values are retained as NaN
dst_limitation: Timestamps are naive UK local wall-clock times. The repeated hour during the 2013-10-27 DST fall-back cannot be uniquely disambiguated from these fields; readings in the repeated hour may share the same one-minute bins.
